title_en: AI Tools for the Investment Firm – Ben Harrison (EP.522)
title_zh: 投资公司的AI工具 —— Ben Harrison（第522期）
subtitle_zh: Intapp 行业总裁 Ben Harrison 谈公司级AI（firm AI）、智能体工作流如何重塑私募资本的寻源、募资与交易生命周期管理，以及治理与安全的重要性。
description: AI Tools for the Investment Firm – Ben Harrison (EP.522)

turns.en: This is a big question. It's in the news, daily or weekly. You're starting to watch the big public firms at least hold constant new analysts and associate classes, maybe trim them some. The addressable market question of replacing human capital inside of these firms is a trick you want. You get on either sides of this debate.
turns.zh: 这是个大问题，几乎每天每周都上新闻。你会开始看到那些大型上市公司，至少把新招的分析师和 Associate 班级规模维持不变，甚至可能削减一些。至于用“替代公司内部人力资本”来估算可服务市场（addressable market），这是个棘手的问题，人们在这场辩论的两端各执一词。

turns.en: On the future of the investment professional itself, I'm not sure how it stands on it. Knowing that it took me days and weeks to build models and decks, being able to do that now in hours. Man, he's still got a digested and iterated. It's not perfect. There's going to be some major margin pickup in the junior ranks that we've been using
turns.zh: 至于投资专业人士本身的未来，我还说不准自己持什么立场。想当年我搭建模型和演示材料要花好几天甚至好几周，而现在几小时就能搞定。当然，成果还得人去消化和迭代，并不完美。在我们一直用来

turns.en: in these industries to process data and information. We've got a lot of clients who have AI agents sitting in an investment committee to see what it can do and to see what recommendations it makes. Is the investment committee going to be an AI agent? I don't think so. But are they going to use it to help for sure?
turns.zh: 在这些行业里处理数据和信息的初级岗位上，利润率会有大幅提升。我们有很多客户让AI智能体（AI agent）坐在投资委员会里，看它能做什么、会给出什么建议。投资委员会将来会变成一个AI智能体吗？我不这么认为。但他们肯定会用它来辅助。

turns.en: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allicators. I guess on today's show is Ben Harrison, president of industries at INTAP, the leading provider of software solutions to professional and financial services firms. Ben first joined me three years ago to discuss deal cloud in TAP's platform serving the private capital community.
turns.zh: 我是 Ted Seides，这里是 Capital Allocators。今天节目的嘉宾是 Ben Harrison，他是 Intapp 的行业总裁（president of industries）；Intapp 是面向专业服务和金融服务公司的领先软件解决方案提供商。Ben 三年前第一次来做客，当时我们聊的是 DealCloud——Intapp 服务私募资本群体的平台。

turns.en: Since then, INTAP has nearly tripled in size and the rapid development of AI has created an entirely new opportunity for the business. Our conversation explores what Ben calls firm AI, moving beyond using AI to conduct research, build models or create presentations, to deploying agents that draw on a firm's institutional memory
turns.zh: 从那以后，Intapp 的规模几乎增长了两倍，而AI的迅猛发展也为这项业务创造了全新的机会。我们的对话探讨了 Ben 所称的公司级AI（firm AI）——不只是用AI来做研究、搭模型或做演示材料，而是部署能够调用一家公司机构记忆的智能体，

turns.en: and execute its workflows. We discuss how AI is changing sourcing in origination, fundraising, deal lifecycle management, and staffing of investment firms. We also cover the critical importance of governance and security, lessons from the combination of deal cloud and INTAP and Ben's perspective on the next leg of growth for the business.
turns.zh: 并执行公司的工作流。我们讨论了AI如何改变项目寻源与开发、募资、交易生命周期管理，以及投资公司的用人配置。我们还谈到了治理与安全的极端重要性、DealCloud 与 Intapp 合并带来的经验，以及 Ben 对业务下一段增长的看法。

turns.en: Before we get going, you're on a plane headed to an annual meeting. And this time of year, you're definitely on a plane headed to an annual meeting. With all the travel in front of you, it's a very busy time, so I'll keep this particularly short. Before you dose off in the thin air of the cabin,
turns.zh: 正式开始之前——此刻你多半正坐在飞往某个年会的飞机上，而这个时节，你八成就是在赶年会的路上。前面还有那么多行程，这是段非常忙碌的日子，所以我就长话短说。趁你还没在机舱稀薄的空气里打盹，

turns.en: that's a great time to let the soothing sounds of Capital Allicators fill your ears. And when you find yourself at a cocktail party at one of those meetings in that uncomfortable moment, where you're not sure who to talk to or what to say, that's a fantastic time to tell them about the Capital Allicators podcast.
turns.zh: 那正好是让 Capital Allocators 舒缓的声音充盈你双耳的好时机。而当你在这些会议的鸡尾酒会上，遇到那种不知道该跟谁聊、该说什么的尴尬时刻，那也正是向别人安利 Capital Allocators 播客的绝佳时机。

turns.en: It's a nice breaker that's the gift that keeps on giving. Since you're an event, if you've come to one of ours, that's a great time to tell someone you think highly of about our Capital Allicators summits. Because if you know, you know. Thanks so much for spreading the word. Please enjoy my conversation with Ben Harrison.
turns.zh: 这是个不错的破冰话题，而且是那种能不断带来惊喜的礼物。既然你人在活动现场——如果你来过我们办的活动——那正是向你欣赏的人推荐我们 Capital Allocators 峰会的好时机。懂的都懂。非常感谢你帮忙口口相传。请欣赏我与 Ben Harrison 的对话。

turns.en: Ben, great to see you. Thanks for having me. It's exciting to be here. Why don't we start with reiterating the core value proposition of Intapp. The company's Palo Alto based started with a data integration appliance product for law firms 25 years ago. Over the years, the business was built with a series of software and capabilities
turns.zh: Ben，很高兴见到你。谢谢你邀请我，能来这里我很兴奋。我们不妨先重申一下 Intapp 的核心价值主张。这家公司总部在帕洛阿尔托（Palo Alto），25年前起步时做的是一款面向律所的数据集成设备产品。多年来，这项业务是靠一系列软件和能力建立起来的，

turns.en: that helped law firms run and operate their business. Manage new client intake, new matter intake, manage the conflicts, procedure eight and a half years ago, we merged Deal Cloud into Intapp and that has formed our growth platform. It's a tool to help you prospect, source and originate new business. We've got a full CRM capability
turns.zh: 帮助律所运营和管理业务：管理新客户受理、新事项受理，管理利益冲突流程。八年半前，我们把 DealCloud 并入 Intapp，这构成了我们的增长平台。它是一款帮助你发掘潜在客户、寻源并开发新业务的工具。我们平台里有完整的客户关系管理（CRM）能力，

turns.en: inside of that platform. Thousands of clients later, we built some expertise across the risk area, the profitability area, and the growth area of the firm. Compared to when you guys came on the show three years ago, you already had a pre-significant presence in the private equity community with the Legacy Deal Cloud business.
turns.zh: 就在这个平台内部。服务了数千家客户之后，我们在公司的风险领域、盈利领域和增长领域都积累了专长。和三年前你们上节目时相比，当时你们凭借原有的 DealCloud 业务，已经在私募股权圈有了相当可观的存在感。

turns.en: What's changed in the last couple of years? A lot of the company's growth has been taking care of our existing clients and growing with them on top of our core platforms. We have thousands of firms using that platform today. The biggest difference is the size and the scale of the company. We've been growing consistently
turns.zh: 过去这几年有什么变化？公司的很多增长，来自在核心平台之上服务好现有客户、并随他们一起成长。今天有数千家公司在用这个平台。最大的不同在于公司的体量和规模。过去几年我们一直在稳定增长，

turns.en: over the past few years. We've been growing profitably with about $600 million business today as compared to about four or five years ago. The IPO was almost a $200 million company. There's been huge moves over the past few years from cloud to SaaS, to vertical SaaS, to AI, to vertical AI. The company has been steady.
turns.zh: 而且是盈利性增长。今天这已是一门约6亿美元的业务，而四五年前我们IPO时，公司体量还接近2亿美元。过去几年行业发生了巨大变迁：从云，到软件即服务（SaaS），到垂直SaaS，再到AI，再到垂直AI。而公司一直很稳健。

turns.en: The markets are changing pretty rapidly. What our clients do during the day, the type of solutions that they're looking for, the ways that they're looking to run their firm, and the ways that they're looking to support the professionals who work inside of those organizations is rapidly developing. The past two years have been
turns.zh: 市场变化相当快。客户日常做什么、他们在找什么类型的解决方案、他们希望怎样运营公司、希望怎样支持公司里的专业人士——这些都在快速演变。而过去两年，是

turns.en: the most rapid pace of change with the introduction of these frontier models. We're almost repositioning our entire stack in all of our products to the AI native solutions. As you look at that change as a technology provider from the SaaS-based to AI, what are you doing today with AI that you're delivering to your clients?
turns.zh: 随着这些前沿模型（frontier models）的问世，变化最快的时期。我们几乎在把所有产品的整套技术栈重新定位为AI原生解决方案。作为一家技术提供商，面对从基于SaaS到AI的这一转变，你今天在用AI为客户交付些什么？

turns.en: They have been using our technology and our products to run their organizations for decades. The way that they use those products now have completely changed. The level of automation that we've been able to introduce with agent to AI is incredible. When you see software executing and moving through organizations
turns.zh: 几十年来，客户一直在用我们的技术和产品来运营他们的组织。而如今他们使用这些产品的方式已经彻底改变。我们借助代理式AI（agentic AI）所能引入的自动化程度令人惊叹。当你看到软件在组织内部自动执行、自动流转，

turns.en: without manual intervention, it's amazing. We've all enjoyed the back and forth of GPT and cloud and the question answer format when you take the power of those models, they start to deploy them through agent workflows in the organization. The level of speed and the efficiency that you can drive and supporting the broader company
turns.zh: 无需人工干预，那真的很神奇。我们都体验过 GPT、Claude 那种一问一答的来回互动；而当你把这些模型的能力，通过智能体工作流部署到组织里时，你在支撑整个公司运转上所能带来的速度和效率，

turns.en: is material. We've been at that concept pre-AI as well. If you look at the original goals of the products, it was to help you run your company and to help you do it better. No matter the platform or the solution, it was to help you harness and manage data to use that to make better decisions and enable your team.
turns.zh: 是相当可观的。其实在AI出现之前，我们就已经在践行这个理念了。如果你看看这些产品最初的目标，就是帮助你运营公司、并帮你运营得更好。无论哪个平台或解决方案，都是帮你驾驭和管理数据，用数据做出更好的决策，并赋能你的团队。

turns.en: That's what we've been doing with our risk and probability and growth platforms for a long time. We were introducing automation into those products from the beginning. We have workflow engines that would run automatically if something happened. We were also auto-updating data. I'll never forget the first Thompson OneBanker add-in
turns.zh: 长久以来，这正是我们在风险、盈利和增长平台上一直在做的事。从一开始，我们就在往这些产品里引入自动化。我们有工作流引擎，一旦触发某个条件就会自动运行。我们还会自动更新数据。我永远不会忘记第一款 Thomson One Banker 插件，

turns.en: for the analysts and the Kappa IQ sync. The Pitchbook connector when it came out, we were using API and calls to automate data. That was a huge lift and value driver because it took some of the manual work out of using software. Most recently, we've been automating proprietary data of the firm. Your systems, whether it's outlook or email
turns.zh: 面向分析师的那款，还有 CapIQ 同步功能。PitchBook 连接器推出时，我们就在用API调用来自动化数据。那是个巨大的价值驱动因素，因为它把使用软件时的一部分手工活儿给消掉了。最近，我们一直在自动化公司自身的专有数据——你的各种系统，无论是 Outlook、电子邮件，

turns.en: or your internal databases, other software products, workday SAP, anything you use to manage. The business can be full of data. If we can sync that data and auto-update that data, move it back and forth without users of the software having to touch it, you get a big pick-up. The most recent one was that Rell Intel capability
turns.zh: 还是你的内部数据库、其他软件产品、Workday、SAP，任何你用来管理业务的东西，都可能装满了数据。如果我们能同步这些数据、自动更新，让它们来回流转而软件用户无需手动触碰，效率就会大幅提升。最近的一项是那个关系智能能力，

turns.en: where you automated the relationship intelligence of your firm. Ted and his Ben, Ben Asdeb, this how much we talked, this how much we emailed back and forth. Our partners at the organization can see that relationship. They can mind that, use that to the benefit of their coverage of the client. What happened in the last 18 to 24 months
turns.zh: 它把你公司里的人际关系智能自动化了。比如 Ted 和 Ben 这样的两个人，我们聊了多少、来回发了多少邮件，公司里的合伙人就能看到这段关系。他们可以挖掘并利用这些信息，来更好地维护对该客户的覆盖。而过去18到24个月里发生的，

turns.en: with the agentic automation is the biggest step we've ever had in the ability to take the software and run it autonomously for the organization. Today, this super complex work flows the deal lifecycle management, fundraising and LP management, each of the different areas of the business that have a procedure behind it. We can drive speed
turns.zh: 就是代理式自动化，这是我们有史以来在“让软件为组织自主运行”这一能力上迈出的最大一步。如今，面对那些超级复杂的工作流——交易生命周期管理、募资与有限合伙人（LP）管理，以及业务中每一个背后都有既定流程的环节——我们都能带来速度

turns.en: and efficiency at a level that we haven't seen before. We're pumped up because we've spent a long time building the client base, building the distribution through thousands of firms. We think the software with the agentic AI is more valuable than ever before. When you go to update an existing client or you're pitching a new client
turns.zh: 和前所未有的效率。我们为此很振奋，因为我们花了很长时间建立客户群、通过数千家公司构建分销网络。我们认为，搭载代理式AI的软件比以往任何时候都更有价值。当你去给现有客户做升级、或者向新客户推介时，

turns.en: with the agentic software that you're using, what's an example of some of that work flow that gives someone a total wow when they see it. There's an important distinction about in-tap, deal cloud, our platform and what it does. If you want to create a pitch deck today, if you want to analyze earnings, if you want to assess a transcript,
turns.zh: 用你这套代理式软件，有没有哪个工作流的例子，是别人一看到就会“哇”一声惊叹的？关于 Intapp、DealCloud、我们的平台以及它到底做什么，有个重要的区分。如果你今天想做一份路演材料、想分析财报、想评估一份电话会议记录，

turns.en: if you want to come up with an idea for a company, if you want to build an LBO model, the research-oriented tasks, a lot of that today is being led by frontier models. Going to cloud, take this transcript, take this earnings release, help me, come up with a two-page deck, do my analyst research, we think that's incredible. Where our
turns.zh: 想为某家公司构思一个投资点子、想搭一个杠杆收购模型（LBO model），这些偏研究型的任务，如今很多都是由前沿模型在主导。你去用 Claude，把这份会议记录、这份财报丢给它，让它帮你做出一份两页的材料、帮你完成分析师研究——我们认为这已经非常了不起。而我们的

turns.en: agentic AI lives inside of these organizations is on the execution of the firm's procedure. By that, let's say we have a long term LP investor in our fund, or we spent five years getting to know the management team of this company that we want to invest in. Usually, the history in the memory of the firm sits in a database,
turns.zh: 代理式AI在这些组织里真正的用武之地，是在于执行公司的既定流程。举个例子，假设我们基金里有一位长期LP投资人，或者我们花了五年时间去了解一家我们想投资的公司的管理团队。通常，公司的这些历史与记忆都存放在某个数据库里，

turns.en: some type of structured data documents inside of the organization. Oftentimes, that's in our systems. If I'm going to go approach a client, pitch a new fund, try and convince them to take our capital, or partner with us and do a deal. If you can have AI draw on the entire history and knowledge of the firm, everything you've ever done,
turns.zh: 是组织内部某种结构化的数据和文档。很多时候，这些就在我们的系统里。如果我要去接触一个客户、推介一只新基金、说服他们接受我们的资本，或者与我们合作做一笔交易——如果你能让AI调用公司的全部历史和知识、你曾做过的一切，

turns.en: surrounding that company and the management team, you have a specific way that private equity firm X takes your plan, your strategy, your operating model, your pitch against that criteria. You're matching those things together and AI output of that is influencing the way that you pursue the situation that you source
turns.zh: 也就是围绕那家公司和管理团队的所有信息；同时，私募股权公司X有它自己的一套标准，用来衡量你的计划、策略、运营模型和推介。你把这些东西相互匹配，AI据此产出的结果，会影响你去推进这个项目的方式——无论是寻源

turns.en: or originate that you manage the relationship. That's what we're calling firm AI. The ability to draw on the institutional memory of the firm and the ability to use the past, the history, documents, the outputs, everything that surrounds that company so that you can be better in that next conversation or in that next pitch.
turns.zh: 还是开发项目、还是维护关系。这就是我们所说的公司级AI：调用公司机构记忆的能力，以及利用过去、历史、文档、产出——围绕那家公司的一切——的能力，好让你在下一场对话或下一次推介中表现得更好。

turns.en: You've got the frontier models and there's a ton of firms out there that are automating the work, automating an analyst model. It's amazing because many of us were analysts. That certainly was. I did the wee hours of the morning, the idea that you don't step all night is awesome. We're taking that one level further
turns.zh: 你有前沿模型，外面还有一大堆公司在把工作自动化、把分析师的活儿自动化。这很了不起，因为我们很多人当年都是分析师。我确实干过，熬到凌晨——一想到你再也不用通宵熬夜，那感觉太棒了。而我们要把这件事再往前推一层，

turns.en: into the firm's procedure to help the firm run and manage the business specifically. How different does that look from a longstanding existing client where you've been housing all of this information and someone you're onboarding for the first time? We feel fortunate to have the 20 plus years under our belt because what happened
turns.zh: 深入到公司的具体流程里，帮助公司运营和管理业务。那么，对一个你们已经托管了所有这些信息的老客户，和对一个第一次上手的新客户，情况有多大不同？我们很庆幸自己已经有20多年的积累，因为在那段时间里发生的，

turns.en: in that timeframe was our clients taught us how their organizations run. We work with 10 of the top 10 private equity firms, 10 of the top 10 private credit firms, 9 of the top 10 secondary firms, and we have a deep appreciation for the level of complexity of fundraising, the investment in deal lifecycle management process,
turns.zh: 是我们的客户教会了我们他们的组织如何运转。我们与排名前10的私募股权公司中的10家、排名前10的私募信贷公司中的10家、排名前10的二级市场公司中的9家都有合作，因此我们对募资、投资与交易生命周期管理流程的复杂程度有很深的体会，

turns.en: of running those portfolio companies, once your post acquisition, trying to drive value, the exit as well. That level of fluency has made its way into our software procedure. These businesses over the years have gotten big, they've gotten complex to run. We were putting the procedure in with the software to run and scale as businesses.
turns.zh: 也包括收购之后如何运营那些组合公司、如何驱动价值，以及退出环节。这种娴熟的理解已经融入我们的软件流程之中。这些年来，这些业务越做越大、运营也越来越复杂。我们把流程连同软件一起植入，让这些业务能够运营并规模化。

turns.en: It is that procedure a context-aware, agent, AI, agent can run through, learn, process and automate where you can get incredible outcome. For the existing clients, we have done that in space. You spend years working together, you spend years refining the deployments, making them better and better and higher value for each firm.
turns.zh: 正是这套流程，让一个具备上下文感知能力的AI智能体能够贯穿其中，去学习、处理并自动化，从而带来惊人的成果。对现有客户，我们已经在这么做了。你花多年时间与他们协作，花多年时间打磨部署方案，让它对每家公司都越来越好、价值越来越高。

turns.en: For the new client, maybe that's just a new firm and they haven't built it yet. There's never been a better time to make the technology investment, because it's never been more valuable. It's never been easier. Instead of maintaining software API or data integrations in the previous era of automation, we're doing it in the AI era,
turns.zh: 对新客户来说，也许那是家新公司，还没搭建起这些。但从来没有比现在更好的时机去做这项技术投资了，因为它从来没有像现在这样有价值，也从来没有这样容易。以往那个自动化时代，你得去维护软件API或数据集成；而如今我们在AI时代做这件事，

turns.en: and that is so much easier than it was a couple years ago. It's fun for the new clients as a whole new day.
